svg.text: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES | DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION | REGION I | SDO ILOCOS NORTE
Dumalneg National High School - Feature-by-Feature System Specification

g.text: Dumalneg National High School serves learners across remote barangays (Cabaritan, Kalabakan, Quibel, San Isidro), including Indigenous Peoples (Isnag) and 4Ps beneficiaries.
Dumal-NEXT eliminates geographic and financial enrollment barriers through a 4-portal system with client-side image compression, real-time tracking, and automated schedule deconfliction.
Complete 5-step basic education intake, upload compressed PSA/Form 138, track review status, download official enrollment PDF.
Inspect personal weekly timetable, locate classrooms, manage assigned advisory class roster, access learner emergency contact data.
Adjudicate applications, enforce 40-student quota, run 3-way conflict detection, manage dynamic academic calendar terms.
• Legal name matching PSA certificate and Gmail.
• Supabase Auth SSR with 6-digit confirmation code.
• Auto-focus numeric inputs with 60s resend cooldown.
Grade 7-12, New/Transferee/Returning, School ID & Gen Avg.
12-digit LRN validation, PSA number, Date of Birth & age calc.
Isnag IP community selection & 4Ps Household ID validation.
Father, Mother (Maiden), Legal Guardian contact details.
JHS Regular vs. SPS; SHS Academic/TVL Track & Strands.
Special Needs Education (SNEd) manifestation & PWD ID.
DepEd Data Privacy consent statement & certification.
• Client-side pdf-lib DepEd Enrollment Certificate download.
• Lifecycle: Draft > Submitted > Under Review > Approved.
• Revision banner with registrar deficiency remarks.
• 1-Click fast-track enrollment for verified continuing learners.
• Today's active teaching schedule with time markers.
• Weekly view: Mon to Fri (7:00 AM - 5:00 PM).
• Print / Export personal weekly teaching assignment.
• Enrolled student roster for designated advisory class.
• High-density virtualized table with real-time sync.
• Debounced instant search across Name, LRN, Ref No.
• Faceted filters: Grade (7-12), Track, Strand, Status.
• Left pane: Complete student demographic dossier.
• Right pane: Pan-and-zoom inspection for PSA / Form 138.
• Approve: Assigns section & releases enrollment slip.
• Return for Revision: Pre-set checklist + custom remarks.
• DepEd School Form 1 (SF-1) Masterlist Excel/CSV export.
• Interactive visual clash markers prevent double-booking.
• Global toggle to open/close admissions intake window.
• Enforce single active term constraint via database RPC.
• Search & manage accounts across student, teacher, admin.
• Dispatch email invitations for new faculty and staff.
• Role switching with privilege escalation guards.
• Register campus buildings, floor levels, room names.
• Configure physical desk capacities & specialized labs.
• Real-time Supabase connection health telemetry & ping.
• System-wide security audit trail (term activations, updates).
• Target: Seamless operation on throttled 3G cellular (1.6 Mbps).
• Client-side HTML5 canvas image scaling ensures uploads < 350KB.
• LocalStorage autosave prevents loss of form data on disconnection.
• Initial JavaScript bundle size < 180KB per portal.
• Compliance with RA 10173 (Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012).
• PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) on all demographic tables.
• Learners strictly isolated: can only view own applications.
• Storage bucket documents accessed exclusively via signed URLs.
• DepEd Order No. 03, s. 2018 (Basic Education Enrollment Policy).
• DepEd School ID 300017 embedded on all official certificates.
• DepEd Color Palette (#002060 Navy, #FFFFFF White, #F59E0B Gold).
• Zero-emoji policy with clean stroke-based SVG icons throughout.
6-digit code received; 60s cooldown strictly enforced; auto-advance focus.
Zod schema validates 12-digit LRN, PSA number, 4Ps ID; LocalStorage autosave.
Mobile camera image scaled to max 1600px, 0.72 quality, resulting in < 350KB file.
Hard validation lock blocks assigning 41st student; meter shows red locked bar.
Detects overlapping teacher, room, and section slots in real time under 50ms.
Admin can activate new school year and quarters without touching frontend code.
